models.name: Nano Banana 2.1

via.price_source: Reed, 11 Nov: "For the pictures (any nano banana or omni flash) you should be going through googles api directly. It is cheaper and better." Google bills Nano Banana 2.1 by output tokens at $30.00 per 1M: a 1K picture 1,120 tokens ($0.0336), 2K 1,680 ($0.0504), 4K 3,780 ($0.113) (aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, read 11 Nov 2026), each rounded up so a quote is never under the bill; its prompt and reference pictures are $1.50 per 1M tokens on top, under a cent. Usage records the bill from the tokens Google reports. Used only while BS_GOOGLE_API_KEY is set

models.name: Gemini Omni 1.2

edit.price_source: An edit of a take (its `video` input, up to 15 s, no pictures with it) keeps the take's length and shape (Replicate README, read 9 Nov), so it's billed on the same seconds. Google bills Omni by its output (aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, read 9 Nov: no separate edit price), and Replicate's page shows one rate, so an edit is priced at a take's rate a second until a real edit's bill says otherwise

via.price_source: Reed, 10 Nov: "we go omni through google directly". Google's Gemini API bills Omni 1.2 Flash by output tokens at $12.00 per 1M: 5,792 tokens a second at 720p ("approximately $0.07 per second"), 8,688 at 1080p ($0.104) and 17,376 at 4K ($0.209) (aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, read 10 Nov 2026); 1080p is rounded up from $0.104256 so a quote is never under the bill. No separate edit price, so an edit is a take's rate a second. Input (the prompt, pictures, a clip to edit) is $1.50 per 1M tokens on top, about a cent a take; Usage records the bill from the tokens Google reports (app/providers/google.py). Used only while BS_GOOGLE_API_KEY is set

models.price_source: Reed, 6 Nov: Omni 1.2 replaces 1.1 and makes the realistic style, UGC ("Omni is more for the realistic stuff"), at $0.11 a second at 720p on Replicate (Reed, from its page, 6 Nov). 1080p and 4k aren't used; they keep 1.1's Replicate rates (read 2026-11-03) as a ceiling. Takes at 720p (its 360p draft mode left out). Native audio on every clip, no audio input. Up to 6 reference images, 3 a person, 2 people (docs/prompting/omni-1.2.md). Called on Replicate's official-model endpoint, so no version

models.name: Demucs
models.price_source: Replicate model page 2026-11-09: about $0.0045 a run (222 runs per $1), typically within 4 s on an Nvidia A100; billed by GPU time, priced at the A100's $0.0014 a second (replicate.com/pricing, the one A100 it lists), so the real cost is the run's predict_time at that rate.
